currency.description: Currency of the monetary metrics, from the response

id.description: ID of the metric, such as active_trials or mrr

last_updated_at.description: When the metric was last updated, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

last_updated_at_iso8601.description: When the metric was last updated, as the API formats it (such as 2026-10-18 09:45:00.000000+00:00)

period.description: Period the metric covers, ISO 8601: P0D for now, P28D for the last 28 days
